content: DS1 SL1 Champion runs require all 26 bosses to be defeated with screenshots/videos showing **stats, inventory screen, and boss drops/empty arenas.**
If you used any boss souls for items, show them as well for proof. It is strongly recommended to not use boss souls just for souls, as you are effectively destroying your own proof.

Keep in mind that it may be difficult to show stats and arena in the same screenshot due to the default size of the UI — it is recommended that you **lower the size of your UI down to 0.65x size** so you can easily show stats and arena in 1 screenshot.

content: DS1 SL1 Legend runs require adding **one** of the extra restrictions below onto the base DS1 SL1 Champion run.
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained, especially for higher NG kills.

challenges.title: SL1 No Rolling/Blocking/Parrying
items: Flawless fights are required for this run

challenges.title: SL1 Broken Straight Sword only
items: Red Tearstone Ring is allowed for Four Kings

challenges.title: SL1 Deathless All Bosses
items: Record the full run, includes DLC bosses
First encounter with Seath does not count as a death
Pyromancies and Red Tearstone Ring are allowed

content: DS1 SL1 Master runs are equivalent to adding **two** of the extra restrictions from the Legend list onto the base DS1 SL1 Champion run.
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained, especially for higher NG kills.

challenges.title: SL1 NG+6 +0 Weapons No Auxiliary Effects
SL1 Weapon Level 0 No Buffs/Rings/Auxiliary Effects
items: Weapon Level 0 refers to a +0 Weapon that is on the Standard upgrade path (not a Special Upgrade Weapon, not Infused).

Buffs: consumables like Resins or Green Blossoms, as well as anything that adds an icon underneath the HUD (Grass Crest Shield, Mask of the Child, etc.) is considered a buff, and is banned for this run.
Buffs and Covenant of Artorias are allowed for 4 Kings.
Ring of Fog and Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring are allowed for Nito.

content: DS SL1 Elite Master runs is a step up in the challenge provided by Master, the required bosses remains the same. For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained.

challenges.title: SL1 NG+6 No Sprinting/Rolling/Blocking/Parrying
items: Silver Pendant is allowed for this run

challenges.title: SL1 NG+6 +0 Weapon No Rolling/Blocking/Parrying/Auxiliary Effects
items: Red Tearstone is allowed for this run

content: DS SL1 Grand Master runs is the highest recognised challenge in Onebros, it is by no means the hardest challenge however after discussion we've decided to pull the brakes here and leave it to the runners to push it even further. The required bosses remains the same.
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained.

restrictions.title: Legend And Above Banned Equipment and Strategies

groups.title: Allowed
items: Defeating **Ceaseless Discharge** via the ledge at the fog wall is allowed.

groups.title: Banned
items: **All Pyromancies, Red Tearstone Ring, and Dragon Torso Stone** are banned. They’re too strong.
**Silver Pendant** is banned unless stated otherwise. It trivializes certain bosses.

content: For SL1 No Hit runs, we use **Team Hitless’ ruleset**.
This is a role that will be awarded to anyone who completes **SL1 Any% No Hit**.
This is a role that will be awarded to anyone who completes **SL1 All Bosses** or a restricted Any% such as **SL1 Any% No Roll** or **SL1 Any% +0**.
